blocks.zh: 定量測定原理與方法 暨 微生物鑑定技術
blocks.en: Quantitative Measurement Principles and Approaches, and Microbial Identification Techniques

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解各項定量測定技術(Quantitative Measurement)——成像光學、螢光探針、自體螢光、流式細胞術與固相細胞術——如何各自量測微生物的「數量」與「存活力」
blocks.en: Understand how each quantitative measurement technology (imaging and optics, fluorescent probes, autofluorescence, flow cytometry and solid-phase cytometry) measures the "number" and "viability" of microorganisms

blocks.zh: 掌握混合式平台(Hybrid Platforms)如何將定量與鑑定功能整合於單一系統
blocks.en: Grasp how hybrid platforms integrate quantification and identification in a single system

blocks.zh: 了解微生物鑑定(Identification)缺乏單一標準對照方法的特性，以及 USP <1113>、Ph. Eur. 5.1.6 驗證框架的適用邏輯
blocks.en: Understand that microbial identification has no single standard reference method, and the logic of applying the USP <1113> and Ph. Eur. 5.1.6 validation frameworks

blocks.zh: 說明光譜(FT-IR、Raman)、質譜(MALDI-TOF MS)與核酸(PCR、定序)三大鑑定技術家族的科學原理與適用範圍
blocks.en: Explain the scientific principles and scope of the three identification technology families: spectroscopy (FT-IR, Raman), mass spectrometry (MALDI-TOF MS) and nucleic acid methods (PCR, sequencing)

blocks.zh: 能評估各項技術於 CDMO GMP 場域中的驗證負擔、周轉時間(TTR)與商業效益之間的取捨
blocks.en: Be able to evaluate the trade-offs between validation burden, time to result (TTR) and commercial benefit for each technology in a CDMO GMP setting

blocks.zh: 4.3 Quantitative Measurement Principles and Approaches 定量測定原理與方法
blocks.en: 4.3 Quantitative Measurement Principles and Approaches

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Quantitative Measurement (定量測定): 與 4.2 節的定性偵測(有/無)不同，定量方法回答的是「到底有多少？」——提供實際的菌數或濃度數字，可直接餵入風險評估模型，進而決定產品或原料是否可放行使用。
blocks.en: Quantitative Measurement: unlike the qualitative detection (presence/absence) of Section 4.2, quantitative methods answer "how many exactly?" They provide an actual organism count or concentration that can be fed directly into a risk assessment model to decide whether a product or material can be released for use.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 這就像從家裡的「漏水警報器」(只告訴你有沒有漏水)，升級成「精密水表」(告訴你每小時漏了幾公升)。有了確切數字，你才能判斷問題的嚴重程度並採取對應行動。
blocks.en: This is like upgrading from a household "leak alarm" (which only tells you whether there is a leak) to a "precision water meter" (which tells you how many liters leak per hour). With an exact figure, you can judge how serious the problem is and take the corresponding action.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 定量數據是建立警戒/行動限值(alert/action levels)與趨勢分析的基礎，直接支撐 Contamination Control Strategy (污染控制策略, CCS) 的風險決策——呼應決策階層中「無菌保證」與「產品關鍵品質屬性」的優先順序。
blocks.en: Quantitative data is the basis for setting alert/action levels and for trend analysis, and directly supports the risk decisions of the Contamination Control Strategy (CCS). This echoes the priority order in the decision hierarchy of "sterility assurance" and "product critical quality attributes".

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼定量數據比單純的「有/無」結果更能支持風險評估決策？
blocks.en: Why do quantitative data support risk assessment decisions better than a simple "presence/absence" result?

blocks.zh: 在你的製程中，哪些監測點最需要從定性偵測升級為定量測定？
blocks.en: In your process, which monitoring points most need to be upgraded from qualitative detection to quantitative measurement?

blocks.zh: 4.3.1 Imaging and Optics 影像與光學技術
blocks.en: 4.3.1 Imaging and Optics

blocks.zh: Automated Kinetic Counting (自動動態計數): 系統以固定時間間隔連續拍照，比對前後影像的「變化」來分辨正在生長的菌落與靜態的碎屑(debris)——會長大的才算菌落。Mie scatter (Mie 散射): 光線遇到特定粒徑範圍的粒子時，散射光強度會隨粒徑變化，藉此推算空氣或水樣中微生物的大小與數量。
blocks.en: Automated Kinetic Counting: the system takes images continuously at fixed time intervals and compares the "changes" between successive images to tell growing colonies from static debris: only what grows counts as a colony. Mie scatter: when light meets particles within a certain size range, the scattered light intensity varies with particle size, which is used to infer the size and number of microorganisms in air or water samples.

blocks.zh: 就像縮時攝影(time-lapse)記錄花朵開花的過程——重點不是單一張照片，而是「隨時間的變化」。會持續長大的是活菌落，靜止不變的只是灰塵或碎屑，這也是為什麼動態影像比單次終點判讀更準確、更快。
blocks.en: It is like time-lapse photography recording a flower blooming: the point is not any single photograph but "change over time". What keeps growing is a viable colony, while what stays still is just dust or debris. This is why kinetic imaging is more accurate and faster than a single endpoint read.

blocks.zh: 供應商聲稱培養時間可縮短約 50%——這對 周轉時間 (Turnaround Time, TTR) 敏感的產品(如短保存期限的細胞治療產品)具有重大商業意義：更快放行代表更快交付病人，同時降低倉儲與延遲成本。
blocks.en: Vendors claim that incubation time can be shortened by about 50%. This has major commercial significance for products sensitive to turnaround time (TTR) (such as cell therapy products with a short shelf life): faster release means faster delivery to patients, together with lower storage and delay costs.

blocks.zh: 為什麼「多張影像隨時間比對」比「單一終點拍照」更能區分菌落與碎屑？
blocks.en: Why is "comparing multiple images over time" better than "a single endpoint photograph" at distinguishing colonies from debris?

blocks.zh: 若導入自動動態計數技術能將培養時間縮短 50%，對你所屬 CDMO 的產能與交付排程會帶來哪些改變？
blocks.en: If introducing automated kinetic counting could shorten incubation time by 50%, what changes would it bring to your CDMO's capacity and delivery scheduling?

blocks.zh: 4.3.2 Fluorescent Probe Application 螢光探針應用
blocks.en: 4.3.2 Fluorescent Probe Application

blocks.zh: Viable But Non-Culturable (存活但不可培養, VBNC): 指微生物實際上仍存活、具代謝活性，卻因受壓力、受損或本身生長要求嚴苛(fastidious)而無法在傳統培養基上長出菌落。螢光探針利用可代謝染劑(metabolizable stain)偵測「代謝活性」本身，而非依賴「能否長成菌落」，因此能捕捉到傳統平板計數會漏掉的活菌。
blocks.en: Viable But Non-Culturable (VBNC): microorganisms that are in fact still alive and metabolically active but cannot form colonies on conventional media because of stress, injury or fastidious growth requirements. Fluorescent probes use a metabolizable stain to detect "metabolic activity" itself rather than relying on "whether a colony can grow", so they can capture viable organisms that a traditional plate count would miss.

blocks.zh: 就像用智慧手環偵測一個人的心跳，而不是要求他先跑完一整場馬拉松才能證明自己還活著。VBNC 菌就是「心跳仍在，但跑不動馬拉松(長不出菌落)」的狀態——螢光探針量的是心跳，不是馬拉松完賽證明。
blocks.en: It is like using a smartwatch to detect a person's heartbeat rather than requiring them to run a whole marathon to prove they are alive. VBNC organisms are in the state of "the heart is still beating, but cannot run the marathon (cannot form colonies)". The fluorescent probe measures the heartbeat, not the marathon finisher's certificate.

blocks.zh: VBNC 對無菌保證意義重大：滅菌、防腐劑或環境壓力可能使微生物「受傷」而暫時失去可培養性，但仍具潛在致病力與代謝活性。若僅依賴傳統培養法，可能低估真實汙染風險——這正是決策階層中「無菌保證恆為第一優先」的具體體現。
blocks.en: VBNC is highly significant for sterility assurance: sterilization, preservatives or environmental stress can "injure" microorganisms so that they temporarily lose culturability while retaining pathogenic potential and metabolic activity. Relying only on conventional culture methods may underestimate the true contamination risk. This is a concrete expression of the decision hierarchy principle that "sterility assurance is always the first priority".

blocks.zh: 為什麼 VBNC 微生物對傳統培養法為基礎的無菌試驗是一大挑戰？
blocks.en: Why are VBNC microorganisms a major challenge for sterility tests based on conventional culture methods?

blocks.zh: 訊噪比(signal-to-noise ratio)不佳時，可能導致哪一類判讀錯誤(偽陽性或偽陰性)？對放行決策有何影響？
blocks.en: When the signal-to-noise ratio is poor, which type of interpretation error (false positive or false negative) can result? What is the impact on release decisions?

blocks.zh: 4.3.3 Autofluorescence 自體螢光
blocks.en: 4.3.3 Autofluorescence

blocks.zh: Autofluorescence (自體螢光): 所有活細胞內都存在 NADH、核黃素(riboflavin)等內生螢光分子，受特定波長光線激發後會自然發出螢光——不需額外添加任何染劑，即為「免染色(label-free)」的偵測方式。
blocks.en: Autofluorescence: all living cells contain endogenous fluorescent molecules such as NADH and riboflavin, which fluoresce naturally when excited by light of specific wavelengths. No dye needs to be added, so this is a "label-free" detection approach.

blocks.zh: 就像每個人身上都有獨特的體味，不需要噴香水就能被聞出來。自體螢光是微生物與生俱來的「天然signature」，相較於 4.3.2 節需外加染劑的螢光探針技術，這是完全不需試劑的偵測方式。
blocks.en: It is like every person having a unique body scent that can be smelled without any perfume. Autofluorescence is the microorganism's innate "natural signature". Compared with the fluorescent probe technology of Section 4.3.2, which needs added dyes, this is a detection approach that needs no reagents at all.

blocks.zh: 此技術巧妙保留「過濾+瓊脂培養」的傳統流程，僅將人眼判讀替換為 LED 激發、CCD 影像量化，因此培養後仍可讓菌落持續長大，供後續鑑定分析使用——兼顧快速偵測與傳統確認鑑定的銜接，降低導入新技術的驗證風險。
blocks.en: This technology cleverly keeps the traditional "filtration + agar culture" workflow and only replaces visual reading with LED excitation and CCD image quantification. The colonies can therefore keep growing after the read and be used for subsequent identification, linking rapid detection with conventional confirmatory identification and lowering the validation risk of adopting a new technology.

blocks.zh: 自體螢光技術與 4.3.2 節的螢光探針技術，在試劑使用與偽陽性風險上有何本質差異？
blocks.en: What are the essential differences between autofluorescence technology and the fluorescent probe technology of Section 4.3.2 in terms of reagent use and false-positive risk?

blocks.zh: 為何保留「持續培養」的步驟，對後續微生物鑑定與根本原因調查(root cause investigation)特別重要？
blocks.en: Why is keeping the "continued incubation" step particularly important for subsequent microbial identification and root cause investigation?

blocks.zh: 4.3.4 Flow Cytometry 流式細胞術
blocks.en: 4.3.4 Flow Cytometry

blocks.zh: Flow Cytometry (流式細胞術, FCM): 讓樣品以定義流路(flow path)依序通過光源與偵測器，逐一量測每個粒子的螢光訊號，藉此確認並計數生物粒子。Biofluorescent Particle Counters (生物螢光粒子計數器, BFPC): 利用細胞本身既有的化學物質(如 NADH、核黃素)發出螢光，不需額外染色即可線上(in-line)偵測。
blocks.en: Flow Cytometry (FCM): the sample passes in sequence through a light source and detector along a defined flow path, and the fluorescence signal of each particle is measured one by one, thereby confirming and counting biological particles. Biofluorescent Particle Counters (BFPC): these use the chemicals already present in cells (such as NADH and riboflavin) to fluoresce, allowing in-line detection without extra staining.

blocks.zh: 就像機場的單一通道安檢閘門：每位旅客(粒子)一次只能通過一個掃描儀，系統逐一記錄每個人的特徵，而不是讓整群旅客一起量體溫。這種「逐一通過、逐一量測」正是流式細胞術的核心原理。
blocks.en: It is like a single-lane security gate at an airport: each traveler (particle) passes through the scanner one at a time and the system records each person's characteristics, rather than taking the temperature of the whole group of travelers together. This "one at a time, measured one by one" approach is the core principle of flow cytometry.

blocks.zh: 已知流速(flow rate)即可換算出「每體積螢光粒子數」，但微生物與樣品中其他干擾性生物物質(如細胞碎片)難以完全區分，使得與傳統 CFU 計數的直接關聯性、驗證方式面臨挑戰——因此本技術目前較適合製程監測與趨勢分析用途，而非直接取代放行檢驗。
blocks.en: Once the flow rate is known, the "number of fluorescent particles per volume" can be calculated. However, microorganisms are hard to distinguish completely from other interfering biological material in the sample (such as cell debris), which makes direct correlation with conventional CFU counts and the validation approach challenging. This technology is therefore currently better suited to process monitoring and trend analysis than to directly replacing release testing.

blocks.zh: 為何流式細胞術對「製程監測/趨勢分析」比對「放行檢驗」更容易被驗證接受？
blocks.en: Why is flow cytometry more readily accepted in validation for "process monitoring/trend analysis" than for "release testing"?

blocks.zh: 微流體(microfluidics)如何透過縮短光路長度，讓不透明流體或粉末也能被檢測？
blocks.en: How does microfluidics, by shortening the optical path length, make it possible to test opaque fluids or powders?

blocks.zh: 4.3.5 Solid-Phase Cytometry 固相細胞術
blocks.en: 4.3.5 Solid-Phase Cytometry

blocks.zh: Solid-Phase Cytometry (固相細胞術, SPC): 先將微生物「捕捉」在濾膜等固相載體上濃縮，再進行染色與螢光激發偵測，最後以影像分析或 AI 進行計數——結合了「過濾濃縮大體積樣品」與「螢光快速偵測」兩者優勢。
blocks.en: Solid-Phase Cytometry (SPC): microorganisms are first "captured" and concentrated on a solid-phase support such as a filter membrane, then stained and detected by fluorescence excitation, and finally counted by image analysis or AI. This combines the advantages of "filtering and concentrating large-volume samples" with "rapid fluorescence detection".

blocks.zh: 就像先用篩網把整條河裡的魚都撈到岸上濃縮，再一條一條檢查是死是活，而不是站在河裡邊游邊看(如流式細胞術的連續流動偵測)。先「固定濃縮」，再「逐一檢視」。
blocks.en: It is like first using a net to scoop all the fish in the whole river onto the bank to concentrate them, then checking one by one whether each is dead or alive, rather than standing in the river and watching them swim by (as with the continuous-flow detection of flow cytometry). First "fix and concentrate", then "inspect one by one".

blocks.zh: 與流式細胞術受限於樣品體積不同，固相細胞術可處理大體積、低生物負荷(low-bioburden)且可過濾的樣品——這使其自然銜接既有的薄膜過濾法(membrane filtration)無菌試驗流程，相對降低了驗證與法規銜接的負擔。
blocks.en: Unlike flow cytometry, which is limited by sample volume, solid-phase cytometry can handle large-volume, low-bioburden samples that can be filtered. This lets it fit naturally into the existing membrane filtration sterility test workflow, which relatively lowers the burden of validation and regulatory alignment.

blocks.zh: 固相細胞術相較於流式細胞術，在樣品體積與可過濾性上各有何優勢與限制？
blocks.en: What are the respective advantages and limitations of solid-phase cytometry compared with flow cytometry in terms of sample volume and filterability?

blocks.zh: 若樣品含有大量非螢光惰性粒子，會如何影響固相細胞術的影像判讀？應如何因應？
blocks.en: If a sample contains a large number of non-fluorescent inert particles, how would this affect the image interpretation of solid-phase cytometry? How should it be addressed?

blocks.zh: 4.3.6 Hybrid Quantitative Identification Platforms 混合式定量鑑定平台
blocks.en: 4.3.6 Hybrid Quantitative Identification Platforms

blocks.zh: Transformer-Based Multimodal Spectral Imaging (基於 Transformer 架構的多模態光譜影像): 結合光譜訊號(化學組成)與空間訊號(位置/形態)兩種資料，運用深度學習(transformer)模型同步分析，達到「不需生長、不需染色」即可同時完成計數與鑑定至物種層級。
blocks.en: Transformer-Based Multimodal Spectral Imaging: combines spectral signals (chemical composition) and spatial signals (position/morphology) and analyzes them simultaneously with a deep learning (transformer) model, so that counting and species-level identification can be done together "without growth and without staining".

blocks.zh: 就像監視系統同時具備「計數鏡頭」(有幾個人)與「人臉辨識軟體」(這些人是誰)於同一台裝置中——一次掃描，同時取得數量與身份兩種資訊，不必分兩套系統各自運作。
blocks.en: It is like a surveillance system that has both a "counting camera" (how many people) and "face recognition software" (who these people are) in one device: one scan gives both the number and the identity, without needing two separate systems operating independently.

blocks.zh: 此技術代表 AI 驅動多模態分析的前沿趨勢，也是連接本節「定量測定(4.3)」與下一節「鑑定技術(4.4)」的橋樑——顯示未來 AMM/RMM 的發展方向是功能整合，而非單一技術各自為政。
blocks.en: This technology represents the frontier trend of AI-driven multimodal analysis and is also the bridge between this section on "quantitative measurement (4.3)" and the next section on "identification techniques (4.4)". It shows that the future direction of AMM/RMM development is functional integration rather than individual technologies each going their own way.

blocks.zh: 「免染色、非生長依賴」的鑑定方式，相較於傳統需培養後鑑定的流程，能為 TTR 帶來哪些改善？
blocks.en: Compared with the conventional workflow that requires culture before identification, what TTR improvements can a "label-free, growth-independent" identification approach bring?

blocks.zh: 將定量與鑑定功能整合於單一平台，對實驗室工作流程與人力配置可能產生哪些影響？
blocks.en: What impact might integrating quantification and identification on a single platform have on laboratory workflow and staffing?

blocks.zh: 4.4 Identification Techniques, Principles, and Approaches 鑑定技術之原理與方法
blocks.en: 4.4 Identification Techniques, Principles, and Approaches

blocks.zh: Verification / Fitness-for-Use Approach (驗證/適用性確認法): 由於微生物鑑定並無單一標準「參考方法(reference method)」可供比對，USP <1113> 與 CLSI M52 建議改以驗證新方法是否「適合預定用途」為導向，而非傳統方法驗證中常見的「與金標準比對」邏輯。
blocks.en: Verification / Fitness-for-Use Approach: because microbial identification has no single standard "reference method" to compare against, USP <1113> and CLSI M52 recommend verifying whether the new method is "fit for its intended use", rather than the "comparison with a gold standard" logic commonly seen in conventional method validation.

blocks.zh: 就像法院沒有一台絕對準確的「標準測謊機」可供比對，只能靠多方交叉檢驗(平行測試已知菌株與院內分離株)來建立對新方法的信心，而非直接對照一個公認完美的儀器。
blocks.en: It is like a court that has no single absolutely accurate "standard lie detector" to compare against and can only build confidence in a new method by cross-checking from many angles (testing known strains and in-house isolates in parallel), rather than comparing directly against an instrument accepted as perfect.

blocks.zh: 不一致的鑑定結果須交由獨立實驗室複核，並依技術/資料庫限制或微生物分類學(taxonomy)的可能變動加以說明——這是偏差調查(deviation investigation)文件中常被忽略卻至關重要的一環，直接影響鑑定結果能否支持風險管理決策(材料處置)。
blocks.en: Discrepant identification results must be referred to an independent laboratory for review and explained in terms of technology/database limitations or possible changes in microbial taxonomy. This is an often overlooked but critical element of deviation investigation documentation, and it directly affects whether the identification result can support risk management decisions (material disposition).

blocks.zh: 為什麼微生物鑑定的驗證邏輯(適用性確認)與定量/定性偵測方法的驗證邏輯(比對參考方法)不同？
blocks.en: Why does the validation logic for microbial identification (fitness-for-use confirmation) differ from the validation logic for quantitative/qualitative detection methods (comparison with a reference method)?

blocks.zh: 當新舊鑑定方法結果不一致時，你的實驗室應建立哪些程序來解決與記錄這類差異？
blocks.en: When the results of the new and old identification methods disagree, which procedures should your laboratory put in place to resolve and document such discrepancies?

blocks.zh: 4.4.1 Hyperspectral Imaging 高光譜影像
blocks.en: 4.4.1 Hyperspectral Imaging

blocks.zh: Hyperspectral Imaging (高光譜影像): 捕捉菌落在可見光到近紅外線(400-1,000 nm)範圍內、遠超出人眼可辨識的色彩變化細節，再與內部資料庫比對，做出屬(genus)、種(species)層級的「推定性鑑定(presumptive identification)」。
blocks.en: Hyperspectral Imaging: captures fine details of color variation in colonies across the visible to near-infrared range (400-1,000 nm), far beyond what the human eye can discern, and compares them with an internal database to make a "presumptive identification" at the genus and species level.

blocks.zh: 一般相機只能捕捉紅、綠、藍三種顏色訊號，高光譜相機則像擁有數百個「顏色感測器」，能看見人眼看不出的微小色差，藉此分辨外觀長得非常相似的菌落。
blocks.en: An ordinary camera can only capture red, green and blue signals, whereas a hyperspectral camera is like having hundreds of "color sensors" and can see tiny color differences the human eye cannot, thereby distinguishing colonies that look very similar.

blocks.zh: 此技術屬「推定性(presumptive)」而非「確認性(confirmatory)」鑑定，且受限於相機可擷取的固定波長數量——實務上通常作為快速篩檢工具，仍須搭配其他確認鑑定技術(如 4.4.2-4.4.5 節)使用。
blocks.en: This technology gives a "presumptive" rather than a "confirmatory" identification and is limited by the fixed number of wavelengths the camera can capture. In practice it is usually used as a rapid screening tool and must still be combined with other confirmatory identification technologies (such as those in Sections 4.4.2-4.4.5).

blocks.zh: 「推定性鑑定」與「確認性鑑定」在放行決策中應如何分工使用？
blocks.en: How should "presumptive identification" and "confirmatory identification" divide roles in release decisions?

blocks.zh: 固定波長數量的限制，會如何影響高光譜影像技術對近緣物種的鑑別能力？
blocks.en: How would the limit on the number of fixed wavelengths affect the ability of hyperspectral imaging to differentiate closely related species?

blocks.zh: 4.4.2 Matrix-Assisted Laser Desorption/Ionization Time-of-Flight Mass Spectrometry 基質輔助雷射脫附游離飛行時間質譜
blocks.en: 4.4.2 Matrix-Assisted Laser Desorption/Ionization Time-of-Flight Mass Spectrometry

blocks.zh: MALDI-TOF MS: 將菌體包埋於基質晶體中，以雷射脈衝將基質瞬間氣化並帶動蛋白質離子化，離子在無電場的飛行管(flight tube)中依質量分離，質量越小飛得越快——偵測器記錄「飛行時間」換算出質荷比(m/z)，形成該菌種獨特的「蛋白質質譜指紋」。
blocks.en: MALDI-TOF MS: the cells are embedded in matrix crystals and a laser pulse instantly vaporizes the matrix and ionizes the proteins. The ions separate by mass in a field-free flight tube, with lighter ions flying faster. The detector records the "time of flight", which is converted into the mass-to-charge ratio (m/z) to form the organism's unique "protein mass spectral fingerprint".

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation

blocks.zh:
時間關係：飛行時間(TOF) 與 質荷比(m/z) 成正相關
　→ 質量越小/電荷越多 → 飛行時間越短 → 越早抵達偵測器

指紋辨識範圍：4,000 - 12,000 Da
　→ 落於此區間的蛋白質質譜圖譜，可用於部分物種層級的區分
blocks.en:
Time relationship: time of flight (TOF) is positively correlated with the mass-to-charge ratio (m/z)
  → smaller mass / more charge → shorter flight time → earlier arrival at the detector

Fingerprint identification range: 4,000 - 12,000 Da
  → protein mass spectral patterns falling in this range can be used for differentiation at the species level in some cases

blocks.zh: 如同每個人獨一無二的指紋紋路，MALDI-TOF 將微生物的蛋白質質譜當作「分子指紋」，拿去資料庫比對，找出這個菌落究竟是誰。
blocks.en: Just as every person has a unique fingerprint pattern, MALDI-TOF treats the microbial protein mass spectrum as a "molecular fingerprint" and matches it against a database to find out who exactly this colony is.

blocks.zh: 三種樣品前處理方法(直接轉移法、延伸直接轉移法、甲酸萃取法)分別對應細菌與黴菌/酵母菌等不同微生物類型，選錯前處理方法可能導致鑑定失準或失敗——此為 SOP 撰寫與操作員訓練的關鍵管控點。
blocks.en: The three sample preparation methods (direct transfer, extended direct transfer and formic acid extraction) correspond to different organism types such as bacteria and molds/yeasts. Choosing the wrong preparation method can cause inaccurate or failed identification, which makes this a key control point for SOP writing and operator training.

blocks.zh: 為什麼黴菌與酵母菌需要採用甲酸萃取法，而不能直接使用細菌適用的直接轉移法？
blocks.en: Why do molds and yeasts need the formic acid extraction method rather than the direct transfer method used for bacteria?

blocks.zh: 若實驗室誤用不合適的樣品前處理方法，可能對鑑定結果的準確性造成何種偏差？該如何在 SOP 中預防？
blocks.en: If a laboratory uses an unsuitable sample preparation method by mistake, what bias could this cause in the accuracy of the identification result? How should it be prevented in the SOP?

blocks.zh: 4.4.3 Fourier-Transform Infrared Spectroscopy 傅立葉轉換紅外線光譜
blocks.en: 4.4.3 Fourier-Transform Infrared Spectroscopy

blocks.zh: FT-IR: 以紅外線照射微生物細胞，依細胞內分子鍵結構的不同，產生獨特的吸收/穿透光譜(molecular fingerprint)，再與已知菌種資料庫比對進行鑑定與特性描述，適用範圍涵蓋細菌、真菌與病毒。
blocks.en: FT-IR: infrared light is shone on microbial cells, and depending on the molecular bond structures in the cell, a unique absorption/transmission spectrum (molecular fingerprint) is produced. This is matched against a database of known species for identification and characterization, and the scope covers bacteria, fungi and viruses.

blocks.zh: 就像用「敲擊回音」判斷房間的形狀與材質——紅外線照射細胞後，依分子鍵結構產生獨特的吸收模式，如同回聲頻譜洩露了房間(細胞化學組成)的資訊。
blocks.en: It is like judging the shape and material of a room by "tapping and listening to the echo": after infrared light hits the cells, a unique absorption pattern is produced according to the molecular bond structure, just as an echo spectrum reveals information about the room (the cell's chemical composition).

blocks.zh: 相較於 MALDI-TOF MS 主要適用於細菌與真菌的蛋白質分析，FT-IR 的適用範圍更廣，涵蓋病毒(viruses)——但同樣高度依賴資料庫的完整性與品質，資料庫涵蓋不足的菌種將無法被準確鑑定。
blocks.en: Whereas MALDI-TOF MS is mainly applicable to protein analysis of bacteria and fungi, FT-IR has a wider scope that includes viruses. It is likewise highly dependent on the completeness and quality of the database, however, and species insufficiently covered by the database cannot be identified accurately.

blocks.zh: FT-IR 相較於 MALDI-TOF MS，在適用微生物範圍上有何優勢？
blocks.en: What advantage does FT-IR have over MALDI-TOF MS in terms of the range of microorganisms it applies to?

blocks.zh: 若你的製程常見的汙染菌種不在資料庫中，FT-IR 鑑定結果應如何解讀與後續處理？
blocks.en: If contaminating species commonly seen in your process are not in the database, how should FT-IR identification results be interpreted and followed up?

blocks.zh: 4.4.4 Raman Spectroscopy 拉曼光譜
blocks.en: 4.4.4 Raman Spectroscopy

blocks.zh: Raman-Scattering (拉曼散射): 雷射光與樣品分子交互作用時，因分子振動與轉動引發光子能量偏移，收集這些散射光即形成該微生物組成與分子結構特有的「光譜指紋」，配合軟體與資料庫可在 15 分鐘內完成鑑定。
blocks.en: Raman-Scattering: when laser light interacts with sample molecules, molecular vibration and rotation shift the photon energy. Collecting this scattered light forms a "spectral fingerprint" characteristic of the microorganism's composition and molecular structure, and with software and a database identification can be completed within 15 minutes.

blocks.zh: 就像敲擊不同材質的杯子聽聲音判斷是玻璃、陶瓷還是金屬——雷射「敲擊」細胞後產生特定的「回音」(散射光子能量偏移)，不同分子結構的回音頻率各不相同。
blocks.en: It is like tapping cups of different materials and listening to the sound to judge whether they are glass, ceramic or metal: after the laser "taps" the cell, a specific "echo" (shift in scattered photon energy) is produced, and the echo frequency differs for different molecular structures.

blocks.zh: 因屬化學層面的技術，固定化背景須選用「拉曼陰性(Raman-negative)」濾材，並排除干擾性化學物質——這與第 4.1 節「樣品效應考量(Sample Effect Considerations)」中背景干擾的風險完全呼應，凸顯樣品前處理在所有光譜/化學類技術中的共通重要性。
blocks.en: Because it is a chemical-level technique, the immobilization background must use a "Raman-negative" substrate, and interfering chemicals must be excluded. This echoes exactly the background interference risk in Section 4.1, "Sample Effect Considerations", and highlights the common importance of sample preparation for all spectroscopic/chemical technologies.

blocks.zh: 為什麼固定化背景材質必須是「拉曼陰性」？若使用不當材質會發生什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why must the immobilization background material be "Raman-negative"? What problems would arise from using an unsuitable material?

blocks.zh: 15 分鐘的鑑定周轉時間，對即時放行或偏差調查的決策速度有何實務效益？
blocks.en: What practical benefit does an identification turnaround time of 15 minutes bring to the speed of decisions in real-time release or deviation investigations?

blocks.zh: 4.4.5 Nucleic Acid Amplification Techniques 核酸擴增技術
blocks.en: 4.4.5 Nucleic Acid Amplification Techniques

blocks.zh: Nucleic Acid Amplification Techniques (核酸擴增技術, NAT): 泛指所有以放大 DNA/RNA 訊號為原理的技術家族，包含 PCR 各類變體、反轉錄擴增、16S rRNA 分型與基因定序等，可用於偵測特定菌種，亦可用擴增循環數/複製數估算活菌數量。
blocks.en: Nucleic Acid Amplification Techniques (NAT): a general term for the family of technologies based on amplifying DNA/RNA signals, including the various PCR variants, reverse transcription amplification, 16S rRNA typing and gene sequencing. They can be used to detect specific organisms, and the number of amplification cycles/copy number can also be used to estimate viable organism counts.

blocks.zh: 就像把一小段太模糊看不清的文字，重複影印上百萬份直到肉眼可讀——NAT 就是分子生物學的「影印機」，把原本量太少、無法偵測的 DNA/RNA 片段複製放大到可檢測的程度。
blocks.en: It is like photocopying a short passage of text that is too faint to read a million times until it is legible to the naked eye. NAT is the "photocopier" of molecular biology, copying and amplifying DNA/RNA fragments that were too scarce to detect up to a detectable level.

blocks.zh: 務必區分「微生物分類學(taxonomy)」與「藥廠常規鑑定」的不同目的：分類學著重親緣分類，常用保守基因區域(如 16S rRNA、ITS)，但這些序列長度有時不足以區分近緣物種；此時需採用全基因體定序(whole-genome sequencing)等更高解析度技術。切勿將兩者的驗證要求與適用範圍混為一談。
blocks.en: It is essential to distinguish the different purposes of "microbial taxonomy" and "routine identification in a pharmaceutical plant". Taxonomy focuses on phylogenetic classification and often uses conserved gene regions (such as 16S rRNA and ITS), but these sequences are sometimes not long enough to distinguish closely related species. In that case, a higher-resolution technology such as whole-genome sequencing is needed. Do not confuse the validation requirements and scope of the two.

blocks.zh: 為什麼保守基因區域(如 16S rRNA)有時無法區分親緣關係相近的物種？
blocks.en: Why can conserved gene regions (such as 16S rRNA) sometimes not distinguish closely related species?

blocks.zh: 你的實驗室在何種情境下應考慮採用全基因體定序，而非傳統 16S rRNA 定序？
blocks.en: In what situations should your laboratory consider whole-genome sequencing rather than conventional 16S rRNA sequencing?

blocks.zh: 4.4.5.1 Polymerase Chain Reaction 聚合酶連鎖反應
blocks.en: 4.4.5.1 Polymerase Chain Reaction

blocks.zh: 三代 PCR 技術演進：(1) 傳統 PCR——擴增後才以電泳/雜交/定序分析終點結果；(2) 即時 PCR (Real-time PCR)——每次擴增循環都偵測螢光訊號，可同步定量起始濃度(t0)；(3) 數位 PCR (Digital PCR)——將樣品分散至數千至數萬個微小分區，逐一判讀陽性/陰性，再以 Poisson 統計換算絕對濃度，不需標準曲線。
blocks.en: Three generations of PCR technology: (1) conventional PCR: the endpoint result is analyzed by electrophoresis/hybridization/sequencing after amplification; (2) real-time PCR: the fluorescence signal is detected at every amplification cycle, allowing the starting concentration (t0) to be quantified at the same time; (3) digital PCR: the sample is partitioned into thousands to tens of thousands of tiny partitions, each read as positive/negative, and the absolute concentration is then calculated by Poisson statistics, with no standard curve needed.

blocks.zh:
數位 PCR 分區規模範例：
  20,000 個分區 x 45 μL
  28,000 個分區 x 30 μL
  100,000 個分區 x 15 μL

原理：計數陽性/陰性分區比例
  → 套用 Poisson 分布統計模型
  → 反推樣品中目標序列的絕對濃度(不需標準曲線)
blocks.en:
Examples of digital PCR partition scale:
  20,000 partitions x 45 μL
  28,000 partitions x 30 μL
  100,000 partitions x 15 μL

Principle: count the ratio of positive/negative partitions
  → apply a Poisson distribution statistical model
  → back-calculate the absolute concentration of the target sequence in the sample (no standard curve needed)

blocks.zh: 數位 PCR 就像樂透包牌：把樣品分散進上萬個小格子(partitions)，每格「中獎」與否(有無擴增訊號)一翻兩瞪眼，再用統計方式(Poisson 分布)反推原始濃度——不需要事先建立對照的標準曲線。
blocks.en: Digital PCR is like a lottery bulk-ticket system: the sample is spread across tens of thousands of small wells (partitions), each well is either a "winner" or not (amplification signal present or absent), a simple yes-or-no outcome, and the original concentration is then back-calculated statistically (Poisson distribution), with no need to build a reference standard curve beforehand.

blocks.zh: 數位 PCR 免除標準曲線帶來的系統誤差，特別適合低生物負荷(low-bioburden)或黴漿菌(Mycoplasma)等需要絕對定量的應用情境——對細胞治療產品的原料/製程管控具有高度實務價值。
blocks.en: Digital PCR removes the systematic error introduced by a standard curve and is especially suited to applications that need absolute quantification, such as low-bioburden samples or Mycoplasma, and has high practical value for raw material/process control of cell therapy products.

blocks.zh: 即時 PCR 與數位 PCR 在「定量」能力上的本質差異是什麼？
blocks.en: What is the essential difference in "quantification" capability between real-time PCR and digital PCR?

blocks.zh: 為什麼數位 PCR 不需要標準曲線也能達到絕對定量？這對驗證工作有何簡化效益？
blocks.en: Why can digital PCR achieve absolute quantification without a standard curve? What simplification benefit does this bring to validation work?

blocks.zh: 4.4.5.2 Reverse Transcriptase Polymerase Chain Reaction 反轉錄聚合酶連鎖反應
blocks.en: 4.4.5.2 Reverse Transcriptase Polymerase Chain Reaction

blocks.zh: RT-PCR: 以 RNA(而非 DNA)作為起始模板，經反轉錄酶合成互補 DNA (cDNA)，再進行傳統 PCR 流程。由於 RNA 半衰期短、細胞死亡後迅速降解，偵測到 RNA 訊號更能代表「活菌」而非殘留死菌 DNA。
blocks.en: RT-PCR: uses RNA (rather than DNA) as the starting template, synthesizes complementary DNA (cDNA) with reverse transcriptase, and then proceeds with the conventional PCR workflow. Because RNA has a short half-life and degrades rapidly after cell death, detecting an RNA signal is more representative of "viable organisms" than of residual DNA from dead cells.

blocks.zh: 就像檢查工地是否還有工人施工，看的是「還在冒的煙」(RNA，只有活細胞才持續產生，死後迅速消失)，而不是「已經蓋好的磚牆」(DNA，即使工人已經離開仍然存在)。
blocks.en: It is like checking whether workers are still active on a construction site by looking at the "smoke still rising" (RNA, which only living cells keep producing and which disappears quickly after death), rather than the "brick wall already built" (DNA, which remains even after the workers have left).

blocks.zh: 相較於傳統 PCR 容易受「非活性細胞殘留 DNA」干擾產生偽陽性，RT-PCR 針對 RNA 的特性大幅降低此風險，特別適合活菌計數估算與環境監測(EM)——這是評估分子方法能否反映「真實活菌污染」的關鍵考量點。
blocks.en: Whereas conventional PCR is prone to false positives from "residual DNA of non-viable cells", RT-PCR, by targeting RNA, greatly reduces this risk and is especially suited to viable count estimation and environmental monitoring (EM). This is a key consideration when assessing whether a molecular method can reflect "true viable contamination".

blocks.zh: 為什麼以 RNA 為標的，能降低來自非活性細胞殘留 DNA 造成的偽陽性風險？
blocks.en: Why does targeting RNA reduce the risk of false positives from residual DNA of non-viable cells?

blocks.zh: 在環境監測情境中，RT-PCR 相較傳統 PCR 有何實務優勢？
blocks.en: In an environmental monitoring setting, what practical advantage does RT-PCR have over conventional PCR?

blocks.zh: 4.4.5.3 Gene-Sequencing 基因定序
blocks.en: 4.4.5.3 Gene-Sequencing

blocks.zh: Sanger 定序原理: 在標準核苷酸中混入無法延伸的雙脫氧核苷酸(ddNTP)，一旦隨機併入即終止該股延伸，產生長短不一、末端帶有不同螢光標記色的 DNA 片段。將四組反應以電泳分離、依螢光顏色重建序列，即可還原完整鹼基排列，再比對資料庫得出屬種鑑定。
blocks.en: Sanger sequencing principle: dideoxynucleotides (ddNTPs) that cannot be extended are mixed into the standard nucleotides, and once one is incorporated at random, extension of that strand terminates. This produces DNA fragments of varying lengths, each carrying a different fluorescent label color at its end. The four reactions are separated by electrophoresis and the sequence is reconstructed from the fluorescence colors, which restores the complete base order; this is then matched against a database to give the genus/species identification.

blocks.zh: 就像把一本書的每一頁，用不同顏色的書籤在不同位置卡住(終止延伸)，然後把所有書籤按長度與顏色依序排出來，就能還原出整本書的內容——這正是 ddNTP 鏈終止法還原 DNA 序列的原理。
blocks.en: It is like jamming a differently colored bookmark into a book at different places on every page (terminating extension), then laying all the bookmarks out in order of length and color, from which the whole content of the book can be reconstructed. This is exactly how the ddNTP chain termination method reconstructs a DNA sequence.

blocks.zh: 細菌鑑定常用 16S rRNA 基因「前 500 bp」(速度快)或「完整約 1,500 bp」(精度高)——這是速度與準確度之間的取捨，須在方法確效(method validation)文件中明確載明所選範圍及其理由。
blocks.en: Bacterial identification commonly uses the "first 500 bp" (fast) or the "full approximately 1,500 bp" (high accuracy) of the 16S rRNA gene. This is a trade-off between speed and accuracy, and the selected region and the reason for it must be stated clearly in the method validation documentation.

blocks.zh: 使用 500 bp 部分序列與完整 1,500 bp 序列進行細菌鑑定，各自的優缺點是什麼？
blocks.en: What are the respective advantages and disadvantages of using a 500 bp partial sequence versus the full 1,500 bp sequence for bacterial identification?

blocks.zh: 為什麼黴菌、酵母菌需改用 D2 區域而非 16S rRNA 進行鑑定？
blocks.en: Why do molds and yeasts need the D2 region rather than 16S rRNA for identification?

blocks.zh: 4.4.5.4 Next-Generation Sequencing 次世代定序
blocks.en: 4.4.5.4 Next-Generation Sequencing

blocks.zh: Next-Generation Sequencing (次世代定序, NGS): 相較 4.4.5.3 節逐一分析的 Sanger 定序，NGS 可在單一樣品中同時定序數億條片段，並與資料庫大規模比對，大幅提升解析度與偵測廣度(全基因體層級)。
blocks.en: Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS): compared with the one-at-a-time analysis of Sanger sequencing in Section 4.4.5.3, NGS can sequence hundreds of millions of fragments in a single sample at once and match them against databases on a large scale, greatly improving resolution and detection breadth (whole-genome level).

blocks.zh: 就像同時用上百萬台印表機平行列印一本書的所有頁面，而不是像 Sanger 定序那樣一頁一頁排隊列印——速度快了非常多，但要把海量紙頁正確拼回一本完整的書(資料分析與判讀)，成了全新的挑戰。
blocks.en: It is like using millions of printers in parallel to print all the pages of a book at the same time, rather than queuing page by page as with Sanger sequencing. It is far faster, but correctly assembling the huge number of pages back into one complete book (data analysis and interpretation) becomes a whole new challenge.

blocks.zh: NGS 會將樣品中「所有」核酸都定序出來，包括背景菌相、非存活微生物與宿主來源 DNA——切勿未經資料分析策略篩選就直接將原始定序結果解讀為「存活污染」，這是導入 NGS 作為汙染調查工具時最容易誤判的風險點，須於數據判讀 SOP 中明確規範相關性篩選標準。
blocks.en: NGS sequences "all" the nucleic acids in a sample, including background flora, non-viable microorganisms and host-derived DNA. Do not interpret raw sequencing results as "viable contamination" without first filtering them through a data analysis strategy. This is the point at which misjudgment is most likely when NGS is adopted as a contamination investigation tool, and the relevance filtering criteria must be clearly specified in the data interpretation SOP.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 NGS 偵測到的訊號不能直接等同於「存活微生物污染」？應如何篩選出有意義的結果？
blocks.en: Why can a signal detected by NGS not be equated directly with "viable microbial contamination"? How should meaningful results be filtered out?

blocks.zh: 相較於 Sanger 定序，NGS 的高通量特性對複雜/混合菌相樣品的判讀帶來哪些新挑戰？
blocks.en: Compared with Sanger sequencing, what new challenges does the high-throughput nature of NGS bring to the interpretation of complex/mixed flora samples?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 定量測定技術(4.3)——影像光學、螢光探針、自體螢光、流式與固相細胞術——共同解決「有多少活菌」的問題，各技術在樣品體積、干擾物排除與驗證難度上各有取捨。
blocks.en: Quantitative measurement technologies (4.3) (imaging and optics, fluorescent probes, autofluorescence, flow cytometry and solid-phase cytometry) together address the question of "how many viable organisms are there", and each technology makes different trade-offs in sample volume, exclusion of interfering substances and validation difficulty.

blocks.zh: 混合平台(4.3.6)將定量與鑑定整合於單一 AI 驅動系統，是 AMM/RMM 技術發展的前沿趨勢。
blocks.en: Hybrid platforms (4.3.6) integrate quantification and identification in a single AI-driven system and are a frontier trend in AMM/RMM technology development.

blocks.zh: 微生物鑑定(4.4)因缺乏單一標準參考方法，須採用 USP <1113>、CLSI M52 的「驗證/適用性確認」框架，而非傳統的參考方法比對邏輯。
blocks.en: Microbial identification (4.4), lacking a single standard reference method, must use the "verification/fitness-for-use" framework of USP <1113> and CLSI M52 rather than the conventional logic of comparison with a reference method.

blocks.zh: 鑑定技術可分為三大家族：光譜類(高光譜影像、FT-IR、拉曼光譜)、質譜類(MALDI-TOF MS)與核酸類(PCR、RT-PCR、基因定序、NGS)，各自在速度、解析度、適用微生物範圍與資料庫依賴程度上有所不同。
blocks.en: Identification technologies fall into three families: spectroscopy (hyperspectral imaging, FT-IR, Raman spectroscopy), mass spectrometry (MALDI-TOF MS) and nucleic acid methods (PCR, RT-PCR, gene sequencing, NGS), which differ in speed, resolution, range of applicable microorganisms and dependence on databases.

blocks.zh: 選用任何 AMM/RMM 定量或鑑定技術時，仍須回歸決策階層：無菌保證優先，其次為產品關鍵品質屬性，最後才是商業與操作彈性的考量。
blocks.en: When selecting any AMM/RMM quantitative or identification technology, you must still return to the decision hierarchy: sterility assurance first, then product critical quality attributes, and only last commercial and operational flexibility.
